How much should Ryan expect to save on fuel over the next year if he purchases Vehicle 1 compared to Vehicle 2?

Ryan plans on keeping his car for 5 years. The expenditure for Vehicle 2 is \$57125.75 over the five years. Which vehicle will provide him better value over this period? Justify your answer with calculations.

Include purchase price, stamp duty and assume registration, comprehensive insurance, fuel (use the calculated amount from part(b)), and maintenance prices do not change over the 5 years.

Part of a hundred counts as a whole one, so there are $255$ lots of $\$100$.
$$\begin{aligned} X &= 255\times 3 \\ &= \$765 \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ X = \$765$$
